P.name: Scalemail
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Shyvana''' generates ''Scalemail'' {{tip|stack|stacks}} from scoring {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against certain enemies. Large {{tip|monster|monsters}} and large {{tip|minions}} grant 1 stack, while enemy {{tip|champions}} and epic {{tip|monsters}} grant 3.
P.description2: {{sbc|Scalemail:}} For each stack, '''Shyvana''' gains {{as|{{sti|{{fd|0.3}} '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{as|{{sti|{{fd|0.3}} '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.

Q.name: Emberstrike
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Shyvana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} will reduce ''Emberstrike's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}. Against non-champions, this effect deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} ''Emberstrike'' can be cast twice in {{sbc|Human Form}} and thrice in {{sbc|{{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}}}}. Each cast empowers '''Shyvana's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and trigger an additional exclusive effect. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of using an ''Emberstrike'' attack, or immediately following a basic attack, the ability can be recast within and {{tt|up to|If the recast is gained by a followed-up basic attack, the window to use the recast is increased (minimum window of 2.5s)}} the next 4 seconds each time, before it incurs its {{sti|cooldown}}. '''Shyvana''' gains {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} on all of her basic attacks while ''Emberstrike'' is active. The attacks deal {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against monsters.
Q.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Shyvana''' slashes her claws, blasting a cone in the target's direction that deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.<!--these casts are NOT on-hit!!! tested with eblade weapon-->
Q.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Shyvana''' slams her tail, dealing the same damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
Q.description5: {{sbc|{{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}} Bonus — Third Cast:}} '''Shyvana''' takes a bite out of the target, dealing {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|'''modified''' true damage}}}}|true}}. This damage cannot {{tip|critically strike}}.
Q.description6: ''All casts {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Shyvana's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Inferno Aegis
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shyvana''' {{tip|shields}} herself for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, with the shield strength increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion. For the same duration, she gains {{as|{{sti|25% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{tt|{{as|{{fd|43.75}}%|ms}}|1.75x modifier}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions<!--within X units-->.
W.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|60 to 140}} {{as|(+ 12% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Increased shield per champion|{{ap|60*0.3 to 140*0.3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*0.3}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description2: After 1 second, ''Inferno Aegis'' can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Shyvana''' consumes the shield to explode, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}} Bonus:}} If the explosion hits an enemy champion, '''Shyvana''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for {{pp|60 + (100-60)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{pp|4 + (8-4)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''missing''' health)}}.

E.name: Molten Burst
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shyvana''' launches a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slowing}} them by 30% for 2 seconds.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 110}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 80}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description2:
{{sbc|{{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}} Bonus:}} The fireball is wider, can pass through enemies, and deals {{ap|1.25*100-100}}% increased damage. Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, and after reaching maximum range, the fireball sets an explosion upon the targets struck and at the location that applies the same effects. ''Molten Burst'' will also scorch the ground it touches beneath for 2 seconds. Enemies within a scorched field are dealt {{pp|15/4;20/4;25/4|6;11;16|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5/4}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{ap|1/4}} seconds, for a total maximum damage of {{pp|15*2;20*2;25*2|6;11;16|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*2}}% AP)}}.

Enemies may be damaged by only one scorched field at a time. Subsequent explosions against the same target deal {{ap|0.4*100}}% damage.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Increased/Explosion Magic Damage|{{ap|50*1.25 to 110*1.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*1.25 to 80*1.25}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.25}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Explosion Damage|{{ap|50*1.25*0.4 to 110*1.25*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*1.25*0.4 to 80*1.25*0.4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*1.25*0.4}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Cast time in Human Form}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.3333}}|Cast time in Dragon Form}}}}

R.name: Dragon's Descent
R.description: {{sbc|Passive - Fury:}} '''Shyvana''' generates {{tip|Fury|{{as|Dragon Fury}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while in {{sbc|Human Form}}. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} also generate {{as|{{fd|1.25}} Dragon Fury}} for each enemy damaged, up to once per enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} and increased{{ft|by {{ap|(3-1)*100}}%|to {{as|{{ap|1.25*3}}|Fury}}}}during {{sbc|Dragon Form}}. Against non-champions damaged by abilities, the generated amount is reduced to{{ft|25%.|{{as|{{ap|1.25*0.25}}|Fury}} and {{tt|{{as|{{ap|1.25*3*0.25}}|Fury}}|After applying the {{fd|3}}x Fury generation multiplier while in Dragon Form}} {{as|Dragon Fury}} during {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Dragon Form}}, respectively.}}'''Shyvana''' gains 1% '''bonus''' {{as|Dragon Fury}} generation from all sources per 1 [[ultimate haste]]. '''Shyvana''' gains {{as|100 Dragon Fury}} upon learning ''Dragon's Descent''.
R.leveling: {{st|Dragon Fury Generation per 0.5 Seconds|{{as|{{ap|0.5/2 to 1/2}}|Fury}}|Dragon Fury Generation per Second|{{as|{{ap|0.5 to 1}}|Fury}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Shyvana''' transforms into {{sbc|Dragon Form}} and {{tip|dash|flies}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to the target location, breathing fire in a cone along the way that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|fear|fears}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for the same duration.
R.description3: {{sbc|Dragon Form}}: '''Shyvana''' gains {{sti|health|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased {{tip|size}}. Her basic abilities are empowered to apply an additional effect. She maintains {{sbc|Dragon Form}} at a recurring cost of {{as|Dragon Fury}}, returning to {{sbc|Human Form}} once all {{as|Dragon Fury}} has been depleted.
R.description4: ''{{tip|Fury|{{as|100 Dragon Fury}}}} is required to cast this ability.''
